## File: facebookresearch_mldoc/sampling_rcv2.py

Prompts

```
['run the sampling_rcv2 script with --input-dir and --output-dir to sample RCV2 data into train dev and test sets', 'run generate_samples to sample labeled documents from an input file into balanced train dev and test splits', 'run check_data_sufficiency to verify if example counts meet the minimum required samples for each label class', 'refactor generate_samples to support configurable train size factors beyond the hardcoded 1 2 5 10 multipliers', 'review check_data_sufficiency to understand how it validates minimum sample thresholds against label prior probabilities']
```
